observations: Photos show stacks of used tires at an outdoor roadside tire lot/market, not a single tire or matched set isolated for sale.
Tires have spray-painted size/code markings (e.g. '15', '16') on sidewalls, consistent with used-tire dealer stock.
Sidewalls are dusty/dirty; no brand name, size, or DOT date code is legible in any photo.
Tread patterns are visible from a distance but not close enough to judge depth or wear percentage.
No photo shows the inner sidewall or crown area where patches or plugs would be visible.
No bulge is visible in the outer sidewalls shown, but resolution and angle are insufficient to rule this out across all units.
A person and parked cars are visible in the background, confirming an open-air market setting typical of Abuja tire lots.
Seller's new message is a verbal reassurance only; no new photo or documentation was provided.

identity.kind: used car tires (sold as 'Belgium'/imported tokunbo tyres)

claims.evidence: No sidewall text, brand, or country-of-origin marking is legible in any of the 3 photos; 'Belgium' is a trade term, not confirmable from images.
Photos are taken from standing distance across a stacked lot; no close-up of tread grooves or a depth gauge/coin reference is shown.
Inner sidewalls and tread crowns (where patches/plugs/bulges are checked) are not shown in any photo; only outer sidewalls at a distance are visible.
No DOT/date code or vehicle documentation is shown in any photo.

claims.claim: "I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true"
claims.evidence: A verbal assurance with no new photo, video, or document; seller's word alone cannot be checked remotely.

risks.risk: Actual tread depth could be well below the claimed 90 percent.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of tread groove with a coin or tread-depth gauge against it, for the exact tire(s) being sold.
risks.if_unproven: priced as low/uncertain tread, not as 90 percent

risks.risk: Hidden patches or plugs on the inner tread/sidewall.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the inner sidewall and crown of each specific tire offered.

risks.risk: Sidewall bulge or internal belt separation not visible due to distance/dust.
risks.proof: Close, well-lit photo of each tire's full sidewall circumference.
risks.if_unproven: priced as risk-of-bulge, i.e. as a structurally unverified tire

risks.risk: Buyer may receive a different tire than shown, since photos depict a whole lot, not the specific item.
risks.proof: Photo of the exact tire(s) to be sold, including size and brand stamped on sidewall, set aside from the pile.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified generic used tire, not as a selected matching set

risks.risk: Unknown tire age/size mismatch across the 'set'.
risks.proof: Photo of DOT date code and size code on each tire in the set.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified age and unmatched set

proof_requests: Clear photo of the specific tire(s) being sold, separated from the pile, showing full sidewall with brand, size, and DOT date code legible.
Close-up of tread with a coin or tread-depth gauge for measurement.
Photo of the inner sidewall and crown area of each tire to check for patches or plugs.
Full-circumference video or multiple-angle photos of each sidewall to rule out bulges.
response.reason: A verbal reassurance with no new visual evidence does not change the fact that the photos show a general stock pile, not the specific tires for sale, so tread, patch, bulge, and origin claims remain unverifiable and a worst-case price still cannot be anchored to a specific item.
